tutorial.0.body: Numbers outside the triangle describe touching filled cells. Read each clue from outside toward the board. A 0 means leave that strip empty. Tap to fill, tap again to cross, and again to clear.
tutorial.0.title: 1 / 3 · Four cells
tutorial.1.body: Multiple numbers describe separate 'runs' of filled cells with at least one empty cell between them. Swipe or scroll to see the third set of clues.
tutorial.1.title: 2 / 3 · Nine cells
tutorial.2.body: A strip is a row of cells. Every cell belongs to three strips. Turn to inspect all three sets of clues. Your active solving time and completed turns are recorded; share your result when you finish.
tutorial.2.title: 3 / 3 · Sixteen cells
